title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention
summary: Hold: the meeting-memory PowerShell call can enable generation but cannot select which meetings generate memory, as the control row promises. Microsoft documents a separate parameter for that choice; the rollout dates, default-on behaviour and five-year expiry are supported.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration <Boolean> controls both whether memory is generated and which meetings generate it.
claims.quote: -KnowledgeGenerationMeetingTypes: Specifies which meetings organized by users assigned this policy can generate an AI-generated meeting knowledge file. AllMeetings: Allow generation for all meetings; TranscribedMeetings: Allow generation only for meetings with transcription.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].api.call and its rendered equivalent with 'Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration <Boolean> -KnowledgeGenerationMeetingTypes <AllMeetings|TranscribedMeetings|None>'. Add to its note: 'The meeting-type choice applies only when AllowIntelligentRecap and AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration are both $True.' Keep the existing unreleased/no-effect warning. Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/teams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy.

claims.claim: The Meeting memory UI offers On for all meetings, Only for meetings with transcription, and Off.
claims.quote: On for all meetings (default): Memory is created for meetings with Intelligent Recap. Only for meetings with transcription: Memory is created for meetings with Intelligent Recap that are transcribed. Off: Memory is turned off for your organization.

claims.claim: The AllowMeetingKnowledgeGeneration reference warns that the feature is not fully released and the setting has no effect yet.
claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect.

claims.claim: An administrator UI for inspecting and removing an individual meeting's generated memory is not documented.

Read meeting-memory guidance: organiser recap deletion and administrator PowerShell, no administrator UI.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy is the entry route for configuring memory retention.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. 2. Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration
claims.fix: Keep the documented entry path, but add to controls[3].note: 'This opens the retention-policy wizard. Keep Full directory on Assign admin units; choose Static on Choose the type of retention policy to create; on Choose locations select SharePoint classic and communication sites and include the memory container URLs; configure retention on Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both.' These steps are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies and the memory location at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/ai-archive-teams-meetings.
